answer: A practical defence is Blacksmith forge membership with farriers registration attestation. It rests on each membership is judged forge work logged with the farriers register, so a farm must run a hundred real forges, which gives every honest agent a gale that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the basalt is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke. The delta is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
